published_ranges._fiber_content: USA-made milled carbon fiber (percentage not published)
published_ranges._notes: Alloyed PA copolymer + milled CF, for experienced nylon users; store dry and print dry, nylon-friendly build surface. Nozzle/bed/speed are Atomic's 'published starting settings' on the product page. Density 1.17 (specific gravity, ASTM D792) and HDT from the Nuclear Nylon TDS linked on the page (file dated 2023; v3 not stated on the sheet). TDS also: tensile strength 17,000 psi, tensile modulus 1,100,000 psi, flexural modulus 900,000 psi. Drying from Atomic FAQ. Title does not say AMS compatible.
